test_rust_tokenizer_discarding_comments: test the Rust tokenizer to discard comments and verify token output matches expected tokens
test_rust_tokenizer_keep_comments: test the Rust tokenizer to keep comments as tokens with ENDCOM and STRNEWLINE markers
test_rust_detokenize: test detokenizing Rust code by converting tokens back to source and comparing output
test_extract_rust_functions: test extracting standalone and class-level functions from tokenized Rust source code
test_tokenize_twice_equal_tokenize_remov: test that tokenizing twice produces the same result as tokenizing once with comments removed
